description:
Get a voice agent

Returns the full public configuration of one voice agent, including the system prompt, the opening line, model settings and the recording and retention settings. Internal voice engine identifiers are never included. A reseller key may read any agent belonging to that reseller; an ordinary key only its own. An identifier that is not a number after the `agent_` prefix is removed is rejected with 400.

agentId.description: Identifier of the voice agent. Accepted either as the public form `agent_12` or as the bare number `12`; the prefix is stripped before the lookup.

name: get_agent
title: Get a voice agent
